subject: Request: Ad-hoc incentive grants and one-time merit exceptions (Engineering leads)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Ad-hoc incentive grants and one-time merit exceptions (Engineering leads)

Hi Marissa —

I'd like to request approval for ad-hoc incentive grants and one-time merit exceptions for three individual contributors on the Core Platform team who were promoted into higher-impact roles during the cycle but missed the formal calibration window. This is a time-sensitive ask because payroll needs final numbers by Friday (07/02) to hit the July run. Summary below; full manager notes attached.

Proposed adjustments (one-time cash + equity refresh recommendation):
- Priya Natarajan (Staff SWE) — one-time discretionary cash: $12,000; recommended 0.02% refresh RSU grant (prorated).
- Ethan Park (Senior SWE) — one-time discretionary cash: $8,000; opportunity to add 0.01% RSU refresh or accelerated stock cliff.
- Karthik Iyer (Staff SWE, Team Lead) — one-time discretionary cash: $15,000; 0.03% RSU refresh recommended if budget allows.

Rationale (high level):
- All three were promoted mid-cycle for performance and increased scope; they missed the merit calibration window due to org transition.
- Retention risk: two have competing offers in process (manager notes in PDF).
- Cost center: ENG-CORE discretionary manager budget + leadership reserve (details in payroll-impact.csv).

Requested approvals / asks:
1) Comp sign-off on one-time cash awards (payroll code and GL).
2) Permission to issue small refresh RSU grants outside regular refresh window for these individuals.
3) Confirmation of any compliance/doc requirements for off-cycle equity (DocuSign amendment if needed).

Attachments: payroll-impact.csv, manager-justifications.pdf, proposed-grant-schedule.xlsx

Thanks — I can be on a quick call to walk through details if helpful.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Core Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Ad-hoc incentive grants and one-time merit exceptions (Engineering leads)

Diego —

Thanks for the summary and attachments; I skimmed the spreadsheet. A few items I need before I can sign this off for payroll: 

1) Manager calibration notes for each individual (short bullets) explaining why the off-cycle cash vs. waiting for next merit cycle.
2) Confirmation of which budget GL code to charge; payroll-impact.csv should include the exact GL string.
3) For equity: whether the proposed refresh is a grant off the refresh calendar (requires exec sign-off) or simply reallocation of unallocated refresh pool.
4) Any previous approvals or written offer amendments that might affect vesting schedule.

Quick question about payroll timing — our payroll cutoff for ad-hoc cash changes is 07/02 COB; if you can't get the manager notes by EOD tomorrow, we can do a partial push for the cash and queue the equity update for the August equity run (but equity will need separate approval).

If helpful, loop in Chantal at PeopleDirect (external) for DocuSign and amendment templates — they can run the compliance checks.

-M

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: Ad-hoc incentive grants and one-time merit exceptions (Engineering leads)

Marissa / Diego —

I endorse Diego's request. Short manager bullets here (for your records):
- Priya: stepped into cross-team bridge role after lead departure; led latency remediation that saved >20% infra cost. Rating: Exceeds Expectations. Comp risk: surfaced an external verbal offer during interviews.
- Ethan: delivered two priority P0 features on accelerated timeline; consistent high-impact IC. Rating: Strong Contributor. Comp risk: recruiter outreach noted.
- Karthik: assumed engineering lead responsibilities pro-tem for 3 months and shipped reliability work. Rating: Exceeds Expectations. Comp risk: internal retention signals.

For funding: ENG leadership is prepared to cover the one-time cash from the leadership reserve (GL ENG-LEAD-RESERVE-2026). For equity: prefer minimal refresh grants (prorated) to keep longer-term alignment; happy to sign off if Marissa confirms that we can allocate from the FY unallocated pool and compliance signs off.

I can join a call after 3pm today if you want to run through the attachments.

-Laura

Redwood Inference

Diego / Laura —

Thanks for the manager bullets; that helps. Chantal — looping you for compliance + DocuSign workflow.

Decision / Conditions: 
1) One-time cash awards approved as requested and can be processed in the July payroll run (payroll-impact.csv validated). GL: ENG-LEAD-RESERVE-2026 confirmed by Finance (copy to finance-approvals@acme.com).
2) Off-cycle RSU refresh: pre-approved in principle but requires written exec sign-off (Laura is fine; we also need CFO acknowledgement). Please prepare a short DocuSign amendment template to present to the employees.
3) We will cap refresh grants at the proposed amounts and mark them as "refresh" grants with standard vesting schedule. No acceleration on vesting unless formally requested with rationale.

Next steps (action owners):
- Diego: provide final per-employee compensation codes and finalize manager-justifications.pdf (EOD 07/01).
- Chantal: provide DocuSign amendment template and compliance checklist (EOD 07/01).
- Rishi: confirm communications plan and that managers will inform the employees today.

I'll hold the final sign-off until I have the codes and DocuSign draft, but this is approved in principle.

-M
